verification.word_id_source: November 2025 official HSK 3.0 syllabus; entries 301–500, preserving source serial ID and order. Transcribed from the referenced 2025 syllabus table.
verification.sentence_policy: Two examples per headword. Sentence 1 (style=conversational) models natural interactive or everyday spoken usage, including neutral spoken statements. Sentence 2 (style=written; register=plain_written) models clear beginner-level descriptive, narrative, explanatory, instructional, or quoted written text. Neither style is exclusive to its medium; written does not mean formal/literary, and natural speech/writing overlap. Prefer HSK 3.0 Levels 1–2 vocabulary and grammar; do not force advanced vocabulary to create artificial register differences.
verification.translation_policy: Chinese sentences, pinyin, English meanings, and translations are newly prepared editorial material. They are not individually corpus-attested or independently native-speaker certified.
verification.pinyin_policy: Tone-marked official syllable pinyin for headwords; sentence pinyin is editorial, assembled from 2025 Levels 1–2 lexicon and Unicode Han-Latin transliteration for out-of-list characters, with curated neutral-tone/tone-sandhi handling. Manual proofreading recommended.
verification.taxonomy_policy: Use exactly the 20 shared topic IDs from hsk3_topics.json; no new IDs required for HSK Level 2.
